No open, scholar-attributed, machine-readable Spanish hadith translation dataset was found in the repositories accessible to this pipeline (fawazahmed0/hadith-api has no es/pt/hi/zh edition for any collection; a general web search for standalone open datasets in this language did not surface a traceable, attributable source within scope of this task). This does NOT mean no such translation exists in print/commercial form (e.g. Darussalam publishes some hadith collections in these languages) — only that this pipeline could not locate and verify a redistributable open dataset. Machine translation was deliberately NOT substituted, per instruction. To close this gap: license a commercial translation (e.g. Darussalam catalog) or commission/verify a scholarly translation.
